FILTER_FILE.description: An optional text file containing PubMed feed instructions. It may specify search terms, MeSH headings, publication types, journals, raw Entrez query fragments, a date range, relevance criteria, abstract-only or full-text notes, and a positive note limit or no limit. If not set or empty, all PubMed records in the resolved window are eligible and the default 20-note limit applies.

NCBI_API_KEY.description: An optional NCBI API key. When set, the bundled E-utilities client may make up to 10 requests per second instead of the unauthenticated 3 requests per second.

NCBI_EMAIL.description: An optional contact email sent with NCBI E-utilities requests.
